labels.value: This gift has been posted to accounting, so its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference and funds cannot change and it cannot be deleted. Record a refund instead, or ask your bookkeeper to unpost it first.

labels.shortDescription: Gift in a closed period is locked
labels.value: This gift is dated in a closed accounting period (the books are closed through {0}), so its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference and funds cannot change and it cannot be deleted. Record a refund instead: it is dated today.

labels.shortDescription: No new gift in a closed period
labels.value: The books are closed through {0}, so a gift dated on or before that day cannot be added to them. Date the gift after {0}, or ask your administrator.

labels.shortDescription: Posted to Accounting is written by posting
labels.value: Posted to Accounting is filled in only by marking gifts posted on the Accounting Export page, and cleared only by Unpost on the gift.

labels.shortDescription: Funds of a gift in the books are locked
labels.value: This gift is in the books (posted to accounting, or dated in a closed accounting period), so its funds and the amount to each cannot change. Record a refund instead.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log line for a posting lock override
Pending gift in a closed period
labels.value: This gift is Pending and dated in a closed accounting period (the books are closed through {0}), so recording a refund or write-off would put it into that period. If it will never be paid, delete it instead.

labels.shortDescription: Donor of a locked gift not deleted
labels.value: Gifts from this record are posted to accounting or dated in a closed period, and the books name it as their donor, so it cannot be deleted. Merge it into the right record instead.

labels.shortDescription: Original of a locked gift not deleted
labels.value: A refund or write-off of this gift is posted to accounting or dated in a closed period, and the books name this gift as its original, so it cannot be deleted.
